WITH rejected AS (
  SELECT id, request_type, received_at, due_at
  FROM data_subject_requests
  WHERE status = 'rejected' AND completed_at IS NULL
),
ch AS (
  SELECT r.id AS request_id, MIN(c.occurred_at) AS ch_ts
  FROM rejected r
  JOIN change_history c
    ON c.entity_table = 'data_subject_requests'
    AND c.entity_id = r.id
    AND c.after_data ->> 'status' = 'rejected'
  GROUP BY r.id
),
al AS (
  SELECT r.id AS request_id, MAX(a.occurred_at) AS al_ts
  FROM rejected r
  JOIN audit_log a
    ON a.entity_table = 'data_subject_requests'
    AND a.entity_id = r.id
    AND a.action = 'update'
  GROUP BY r.id
)
SELECT
  r.request_type,
  r.received_at,
  r.due_at,
  COALESCE(ch.ch_ts, al.al_ts) AS rejection_event_timestamp,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ch.ch_ts, al.al_ts) IS NOT NULL
       THEN DATE_PART('day', COALESCE(ch.ch_ts, al.al_ts) - r.received_at)
  END AS days_received_to_rejection_event,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ch.ch_ts, al.al_ts) IS NOT NULL
       THEN COALESCE(ch.ch_ts, al.al_ts) <= r.due_at
  END AS within_due_at,
  CASE WHEN ch.ch_ts IS NOT NULL THEN 'change_history'
       WHEN al.al_ts IS NOT NULL THEN 'audit_log'
       ELSE 'neither_found' END AS source
FROM rejected r
LEFT JOIN ch ON ch.request_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN al ON al.request_id = r.id
ORDER BY r.received_at ASC, r.id ASC
